game_title: Sum Sprint – Hollow Log Trail Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail, a trail through hollow logs: the wood elf archer must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Sum Sprint: Accumulate a total across a loop to pay a toll at Hollow Log Trail.
theme: Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail: a trail through hollow logs
core_gameplay_loop: In Hollow Log Trail, repeat each round: Accumulate a total across a loop to pay a toll at Hollow Log Trail. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the total value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about total to power up the wood elf archer and open the mushroom ring.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Sum Sprint
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how total changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cursed treants in Hollow Log Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
